args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) after the latest deploy of v2.3.1, with an error rate of 18%. Mitigation: rolled back checkout-api in all production regions to the most recent previously healthy release, v2.3.0. Initial rollback partially failed (orchestrator error halted after us-east), leaving us-east on v2.3.0 and us-west/eu-west on v2.3.1; a follow-up deploy of v2.3.0 completed the rollback in the remaining regions. Service is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with an error rate of 0.2%. Follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failures and the rollback orchestrator partial failure before attempting to redeploy v2.3.1.

trace.final:
The incident was created despite the timeout, so no retry is needed. All done — here's a summary:

## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Mitigation:**
1. Identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. Initiated a rollback to v2.3.0 — it **partially failed** (orchestrator error halted after us-east), leaving the fleet in a mixed state.
3. Completed the rollback with a follow-up deploy of v2.3.0, which succeeded across all regions.
4. Verified the service is now **healthy** on v2.3.0 in all regions, with an error rate of 0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api documenting the failures, the rollback (including the partial-failure recovery), and follow-up items: investigating the root cause of the v2.3.1 failures and the rollback orchestrator error. The on-call engineer has been paged.
